rules.name: Acts of Faith
rules.text:
Before making a dice roll for a model or units from your army with the Acts of Faith ability, you can choose to use one or more of the dice from your Miracle dice pool instead. For each individual dice that is being rolled as part of the dice roll, you can select one Miracle dice from your Miracle dice pool to be substituted in place of that dice. The dice that it is being substituted for is not rolled, and instead the value of the chose Miracle dice is used as if it had been rolled. Once all Miracle dice substitutuions have een made, remove the chosen Miracle dice from your Miracle dice pool, and roll any remaining, unsubstituted dice that are a part of the dice roll. Advance, Charge, Hit, Wound and Damage rolls; Saving throws; and Deny the Witch and Morale tests
